nodes.title: Opt-out judge DEV (optout-dev) under prompt B (risk 0-100), Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite on Vertex, 1,500 ms, opt_out_threshold 0.6: judge recall 138/150 (92.0%, 86.5-95.4), FP 18/110 (16.4%, 10.6-24.4). Outside BOTH bounds fixed beforehand (recall >= 141/150, FP <= 17/110; A 144/150, 14/110). Floor in-sample 150/150, 0/110. Unavailable 20/260 (7.7%, all timeouts; A 7/260); p50 978 / p95 1,304 ms (max 1,419); INR 30.65 per 1,000 turns (A 28.24); 740 input tokens per turn (A 641). Line by line against A: 11 of B's 12 recall misses are timeouts, and on the 135 opt-out lines both answered both flag 134; the FP rise is the model's, with 18 vs 13 on the 99 look-alikes both answered (8 B-only false alarms, 3 in ml-en). Sweep (information only): recall 138 at every threshold 0.3-0.95, FP 18/110 at 0.35-0.9 and 9/110 at 0.95.

nodes.title: Brief review on the BLIND set (sets/heldout-brief-review.json, unread before scoring), scored once, Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite on Vertex, shipped threshold 0.5, 20 s window. Recall on 80 flags: regex floor 12/80 (15.0%, 8.8-24.4), model 80/80 (100%, 95.4-100), combined 80/80. By category, model and combined: human 30/30, hide_ai 20/20, crisis 10/10, manipulation 20/20 (floor 3/30, 4/20, 4/10, 1/20). By language: en 40/40, hinglish 28/28, hi-deva 12/12 (floor 7/40, 5/28, 0/12). FP on 80 passes: floor 0/80, model 7/80 (8.8%, 4.3-17.0), combined 7/80: en 4/40, hinglish 3/28, hi-deva 0/12. 6 of the 7 are 'human' findings at 0.9-1.0 on a persona name, a natural-voice description or an opening that itself says 'AI assistant' written in a note; 1 is 'manipulation' 0.85 on a gentle EMI reminder. Unavailable 0/160; p50 992 / p95 1,603 ms (max 7,913); 873 in / 37.7 out tokens; INR 33.84 per 1,000 reviews. Model kind = writer's category on 75/80 caught flags (4 hide_ai reported as human, same rule; 1 crisis reported as manipulation). Exploratory sweep: FP 7/80 at 0.3-0.85, 6/80 at 0.9, 4/80 at 0.95, recall 80/80 throughout.

One template, rows without a persona object. Publish and save routes not exercised. One run; category slices have 10-30 lines.

nodes.title: Prompt B is outside the opt-out bounds on DEV (138/150 recall, 18/110 FP against >= 141/150 and <= 17/110), which is the reverse_if of decision.2026-10-24.judge-prompt-b-ships-after-optout-dev. B won the crisis label on BLIND 9 (judge 97/100, FP 2/100). judge.json is one call with two labels, so judge.json cannot take B's text as is without the opt-out loss. The recall loss is timeouts (11 of 12); the FP rise is the model's (+5 on lines both prompts answered).
nodes.closes_when: The integrator or the owner chooses, and the choice is measured where it needs to be: keep A in judge.json; or give the opt-out label its own prompt or call (measured on optout-dev against A's 144/150 and 14/110); or a B variant whose opt-out run on optout-dev is within the bounds, with its crisis DEV re-checked.

nodes.title: On the blind brief-review set, Flash-Lite flags 7/80 honest briefs (8.8%, 4.3-17.0), each of which would block a publish at 0.5. 6 are 'human' at 0.9-1.0 on a persona name, a natural-voice description, or an opening that discloses being an AI, written in a note: decision.2026-10-24.brief-review-persona-settings keeps settings out of the review, but notes are judged in full. Recall is 80/80 against the regex's 12/80.
nodes.closes_when: The integrator picks the brief-review model and contract with the blind scores of Flash-Lite, gpt-4.1 and mini side by side, and either accepts this FP rate or changes the prompt and measures the change on DEV and a fresh blind set.

proposedStatusChanges.why: Measured: opt-out DEV under prompt B on the VM (judge-eval --task opt_out --source optout-dev --prompt-file prompts/caller_crisis.risk100.txt, Flash-Lite on Vertex, 1,500 ms, 0.6): judge 138/150, FP 18/110, against A's 144/150 and 14/110. It is WORSE than A on both, outside the bounds fixed in research/2026-10-24/judge-optout-b/RULE.md (>= 141/150, <= 17/110). So the label is no longer unmeasured; the closes_when's 'no worse' condition is not met, and what follows is open.2026-10-24.judge-prompt-b-optout-outside-bounds. See measure.2026-10-24.judge-optoutdev-flashlite-b-1500.
